[[File:BlargDroidAmDed-KOTOR2.png|thumb|right|300px|The individual (top right) killed Sullio on Onderon.]]
An '''individual''' was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Onderon Civil War]]<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> in [[3951 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> they [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sullio]], a member of the [[Onderonian military]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[S-0D3-GE3]] discovered Sullio's body immediately afterward, though the murderer destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] not long after it managed to record part of the crime scene. [[Dhagon Ghent]], a local [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], was arrested for the murder of Sullio. However, Ghent was proven innocent through the work of the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]<ref name="KOTOR2" /> [[Meetra Surik]],<ref name="REVAN">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> otherwise known as the Jedi Exile, who used the recording as evidence to clear him of the murder.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sullio's murderer appeared in a recording in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', developed by [[Obsidian Entertainment]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />
